text: とび　おりるのは　ちょっと　こわいけど…　マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは　はやく　かえれて　いいよ

structure.jp: ちょっと　こわいけど…
マサラ　タウンに　かえる　ときは
はやく　かえれて　いいよ
structure.en: you can get back fast, which is nice

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns a verb into a thing, like 'doing it'. とびおりるのは = 'jumping down'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: かえれる means 'can return'; it is the can-form of かえる. かえれていい = 'it's nice that you can return'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but' and softly sets up a contrast. こわいけど = 'it's scary, but'.
